coefficients.provenance: Peak device bytes per attended token (image tokens at 1/16 of each side plus the prompt's) of one MOSS-Image transformer forward. Measured on the moss_image.denoise points: RTX 4090 (CUDA, Ada), bf16, fully resident, device_peak. Implied 0.164-0.198 MiB per token, the most for long prompts (1024x1024: 0.184/0.192/0.198 at 64/1024/4096 text tokens; 1536x1024, 1536x1536, 2048x2048 at 256: 0.167/0.165/0.164), with no constant term. 220000 (0.21 MiB) is the band between the worst point and 1.3x the best: 1.06-1.28x the measured peaks, which also covers the few MB of float32 latents the node keeps. Not measured off CUDA; the entry is unkeyed because the term is GEMM and fused-attention activations rather than convolution workspaces, and the analytic score-matrix term prices a backend without a fused kernel.

points.provenance: RTX 4090, bf16, the real MOSS-Image-Base transformer fully resident, one sample per forward as moss_image_denoise runs it, fused SDPA (score matrix not materialized); peak drop in torch.cuda.mem_get_info polled during the forward, below the pre-forward baseline, over two forwards per shape. Recorded in MiB.
